f2_target_modules: new pure observer projection adapter selected by Trigger-4
problem_or_gap: F2 has strong canonical receipt/runpackage identity and a telemetry spine, but lacks a measured standard-compatible observer projection for cross-tool trace inspection and append-only post-hoc evaluation provenance. A full OpenInference import is too broad for the current need.
proposed_delta: Implement the smallest pure one-way observer adapter: admitted immutable F2 receipt ref+SHA-256 plus a minimal allowlisted query index -> OpenInference-compatible evaluator/span attributes and optional single post-hoc Span Link. Observer IDs remain correlation only. No reverse flow to UnifiedDB, GWT, effects, completion, goals or world truth. Do not import provider instrumentors or external blob upload machinery.
counterhypotheses: Native F2 receipts/telemetry already provide sufficient inspection value, making compatibility projection net-negative after maintenance cost.
Exporter/processor/collector/storage overhead can erase the local thin-shape advantage.
OpenInference convention churn may cost more than a stable F2-native observer schema.
Span-link visualization may add little decision-relevant value beyond immutable receipt refs.
upstream_claims_reproduced: OpenInference-compatible post-hoc evaluation can be represented as a separate evaluator carrier linked to a target observer span.
A strict allowlisted one-way projection can preserve canonical F2 receipt identity without making observer IDs authoritative.
The distilled thin shape remains smaller and faster than the full-field projection under local OTel 1.42.1 OTLP protobuf encoding.
upstream_claims_not_reproduced: No upstream end-to-end performance benchmark was adopted.
No collector/exporter/network/storage/query backend claim was reproduced.
No claim that OpenInference establishes causality, truth, completion or GWT uptake was accepted.
No full OpenInference framework/provider instrumentor integration was tested.
baseline_definition: Compare adapter-disabled/native F2 receipt path against thin projection enabled for the same immutable receipt workload; separately retain the Trigger-6 full-field projection as a negative/overbuilt comparison, not as the intended build.
required_tests: Observer trace/span IDs can vary without changing exported canonical F2 refs/digests.
Positive export allowlist excludes prompt/output/tool definitions/secrets/free-form metadata.
Malformed canonical digest or ambiguous receipt identity fails closed.
Observer-disabled/sampled/suppressed path yields no telemetry and does not mint a negative F2 fact.
No reverse-write surface to UnifiedDB/GWT/effect/completion authority.
If post-hoc evaluation is represented, exactly one intended Span Link is bound to the target observer span.
Repository-hosted deterministic regression for serialization shape and privacy fence.
required_ablations: adapter disabled/native receipt vs thin receipt-ref adapter
thin receipt-ref adapter vs full-field projection
with and without optional post-hoc observer link where applicable
required_measurements: serialized OTLP bytes per representative receipt/event
end-to-end observer-path p50/p95/p99 latency when an exporter/processor is included
CPU and RSS/PSS overhead at representative event rate
drop/sampling/suppression behavior and explicit UNKNOWN handling
inspection/query task success compared with native receipts alone
dependency/startup overhead if OpenTelemetry SDK becomes a runtime dependency
expected_token_delta: 0 model-facing tokens by design; observer telemetry must not expand model context unless separately authorized by a later retrieval path.
expected_latency_delta: Local OTel 1.42.1 build+OTLP encode: thin p50 62.440 us vs full 83.398 us; actual F2 observer-path delta remains UNKNOWN until Trigger-4 measurement.
expected_resource_delta: Thin OTLP fixture 1018 bytes vs full 1674 bytes (-656 bytes, -39.2%); target CPU/RSS/I/O/network impact remains UNKNOWN.
quality_success_metric: Cross-tool/post-hoc trace inspection gains useful receipt-level correlation/evaluation provenance while canonical F2 evidence, privacy, UNKNOWN semantics and authority boundaries remain unchanged; otherwise reject as unnecessary observer complexity.
rollback_or_reject_rule: Reject/disable if the implementation requires full framework/provider instrumentation, leaks non-allowlisted content, creates reverse authority, cannot keep observer IDs noncanonical, shows no material inspection/query value, or fails bounded-overhead tests versus native receipts.
known_failure_modes: observer sampling/suppression creates gaps that can be misread as event absence
random trace/span IDs accidentally treated as causal identity
privacy regression through broad attribute capture
collector/exporter overhead dominating the thin adapter
duplicate telemetry schema becoming a second evidence authority
post-hoc evaluator output incorrectly treated as world fact
